**Download `MacMemoryMonitor-*.zip` below**, unzip it, and drag **Mac Memory Monitor** into your Applications folder.

The first time you open it, macOS will say it can't check the app for malicious software (it isn't notarized by Apple). To open it anyway:
1. Double-click the app, then click **Done**.
2. Open **System Settings → Privacy & Security**, scroll down, and click **Open Anyway** next to Mac Memory Monitor.

Not in the menu bar? On macOS 26, turn it on in **System Settings → Menu Bar → Allow in the Menu Bar**.

Works on Apple Silicon and Intel Macs, macOS 14 or newer.
